item.title: The Small Changes That Ended My Endless Scrolling
item.description:
I went from scrolling 4+ hours a day on social media to under 35 minutes.

Here’s exactly how I did it.

Scrolling endlessly used to be my biggest time waster. I would open Instagram to check a message and suddenly lose two hours to the dopamine hits of the algorithm 😭

When you do the math, it's wild
4 hours a day = 56 full days a year wasted on doomscrolling.
That's almost two months! 😲

We can't just delete social media, but we can be more intentional about how we use it. Reducing screen time isn't easy and a sudden change can be jarring. The key is to make slow and gradual shifts.

Here’s what worked for me:
• Turn off notifications — Stops your phone from constantly grabbing your attention.
• Use an app blocker — Limit distracting apps with Regain App, Digital Wellbeing, Screen Time.
• Try a minimalist launcher — Hide icons to force conscious app use (Olauncher, Niagara, etc).
• Rearrange apps regularly — Break muscle memory by moving distracting apps every few days.
• Clean your feed — Unfollow distractions and follow accounts that inspire you.
• Switch to grayscale — Dull the colours that make apps addictive.

The truth is: social media overuse, especially short-form content, damages our attention span and focus.

Most people wouldn’t have the patience to read this far, but you did... That means you care about your time. 👏

Thanks for reading ❤️

What’s one habit that helps you manage your screen time?
